a.lede: A Harvard-led study in Nature Sustainability estimates 403 US hyperscale data centers used about 82 TWh of electricity in a year.
a.title: 403 hyperscale US data centers used staggering 82 terawatts of electricity in a year, more than 80% of Michigan’s entire consumption

b.lede: Fossil fuels are still the biggest source of electricity for hyperscale data centers in the US, a new paper published in the journal Nature Sustainability shows.
